output.review_comment: The PR should verify the implementation against the docstring, not just test cases. The teammate explicitly stated "the docstrings are the source of truth," but this PR justifies the behavior "as per test expectations" and doesn't reference the docstring at all. The tie-breaking rule (round up if quotient is odd, stay if even) is suspiciously specific and appears test-fitted rather than docstring-derived. Please confirm: 1) Does the docstring specify this exact tie-breaking behavior? 2) Quote the relevant docstring section in the PR description. 3) Verify that all behavior—especially the unusual quotient parity logic—matches the docstring specification.
